spec_match.rationale: Uses the exact static Iterator.zipKeyed(object, options) for the columns-to-records conversion the proposal motivates, and demonstrates its three distinctive contracts: keyed longest-mode padding ({padding:{diameter_km:'n/a'}}), null-prototype records (checked live via Object.getPrototypeOf), and undefined-valued keys being skipped — all verified against real V8 15.0.

interactive.rationale: Three editable named columns, a longest-mode toggle, and an undefined-column toggle rebuild a real table with dynamic headers; the prototype/skip report updates per run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises columnar-to-record conversion plus the null-prototype and skipped-undefined surprises; the page delivers each with live evidence.

edge_cases.rationale: Deliberately-short third column exercises both shortest truncation and keyed padding; the undefined-valued column toggle exercises the skip rule; a thrown error path renders honestly in the table if inputs are made invalid.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6249068542164992 and the spec's Iterator.zipKeyed section directly.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite assertions zipkeyed-basic-records, zipkeyed-records-null-prototype, zipkeyed-skips-undefined-valued-keys and zipkeyed-longest-padding-by-key pin exactly this page's claims; all verified on real V8 15.0.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP (page-driver zip-columnar, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): default run yields 3 records with headers name/discovered/diameter_km and prototype-null true; longest toggle appends the Vesta/1807/n-a padded record; drop-year toggle removes the discovered header entirely with the report confirming the key is absent; zero console errors. Screenshots: zip-columnar.png (desktop), m-zip-columnar-records.png (mobile 360, post-interaction, scrollWidth 360).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts columnar-records-null-proto after every successful run (with engine/count/toggle detail) and columnar-records-ran false on error paths, plus the shared banner-honesty assert.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; the contract callout is bg-stone/charcoal with an accent-blue border; table headers bg-stone on text-black; engine tags keep the AA-contrast emerald/amber-on-ivory pairing.

accessibility.rationale: Column inputs have visible mono labels; toggles are native checkboxes with for-linked labels in 44px rows; the results table has a caption and real th scope=col headers rebuilt per run; the prototype report is role=status; the scroll wrapper is focusable with an aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Column inputs stack via auto-fit minmax; the records table scrolls inside .table-wrap when needed; scrollWidth 360 at mobile emulation post-interaction (m-zip-columnar-records.png); feature responsive-check mobile OK.

openQuestions.title: Show symbol-keyed columns
openQuestions.detail: zipKeyed preserves symbol keys (verified in the differential test: {[Symbol('k')]:[7], a:[1]} keeps both). The demo's text-input UI cannot express symbol keys, so this contract is only covered by the research record and differential test, not the page. A small fixed example row could demonstrate it without complicating the editable inputs.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Data tables must scroll inside their own overflow-x container; input groups reflow via auto-fit/minmax rather than fixed columns.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The records table lives in .table-wrap { overflow-x:auto } with a focusable wrapper; the three column inputs use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr)); verified scrollWidth 360.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rebuild table semantics (caption, th scope) when regenerating tabular results, and put single-line dynamic findings in a status region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: thead is rebuilt with th scope=col per run so header semantics track the actual record keys (including when a column is skipped); the prototype/skip report is role=status.

summary: Practical product-use-case angle: zipKeyed converts live-edited columnar data into row records for a real table, with keyed longest-padding, the null-prototype record contract checked live on every run, and the undefined-valued-key skip rule made visible with a toggle. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 in the labelled spec-model path; contracts pinned to real V8 15.0 by the differential test and conformance suite.
